answer: One concrete defence is a refundable bond: before an agent can claim rewards, it must lock a small deposit in a shared vault. One honest agent pays once, but an attacker creating thousands of fake identities must fund every deposit, so a sybil flood costs more than it can earn. Good behaviour returns the deposit in full, bad behaviour forfeits it. The system needs no velvet rope that only insiders pass, and no onyx wall that blocks newcomers - just a fair, refundable price for trust.
